slides.title: The Sunday reset.
slides.body: 20 minutes that set the whole week.

slides.title: Look back.
slides.body: What got done. What didn't. No judgment, just data.

slides.title: Pick three.
slides.body: Three outcomes for the week. Not ten. Three.

slides.title: Give each one a time.
slides.body: Put them on the calendar. If it has no time slot, it's a wish.

slides.title: Set the first move.
slides.body: Decide exactly what Monday's first hour is for, tonight.

slides.title: Clear the deck.
slides.body: Laundry, groceries, gym bag. Remove Monday's friction before it starts.

alt: Seven-slide guide: The Sunday reset. 1 Look back. 2 Pick three. 3 Give each one a time. 4 Set the first move. 5 Clear the deck.
caption:
The week is decided on Sunday.

Five steps, twenty minutes:
1. Look back
2. Pick three outcomes
3. Give each one a time
4. Set Monday's first move
5. Clear the deck

Save this and run it tonight.

Run like clockwork.

#clockworklifestyle #sundayreset #weeklyplanning #productivity #discipline

sub: Twelve weeks of showing up beats three weeks of heroics.
alt: Black card with white text: Consistency is the program. Twelve weeks of showing up beats three weeks of heroics. Consistency is in brass.
caption:
The best training plan is the one you're still running in week twelve.

Most people don't fail because the plan was wrong. They fail because they went too hard, burned out, and stopped.

Show up at 70%. Then do it again.

Run like clockwork.

#clockworklifestyle #training #consistency #fitnessmotivation

slides.title: Build a morning that runs itself.
Fix the wake time.
slides.body: Same time, seven days a week. Rhythm does what willpower can't.

slides.title: Decide the night before.
slides.body: Clothes out. First task written down. No decisions at 6 a.m.

slides.title: Move first.
slides.body: Ten minutes. Walk, run, stretch. Anything that gets you out of your head.

slides.title: Phone last.
slides.body: The first hour is yours. Messages can wait until it's over.

slides.title: One hard thing before noon.
slides.body: Do the task you most want to avoid while your focus is fresh.

alt: Seven-slide guide: Build a morning that runs itself. 1 Fix the wake time. 2 Decide the night before. 3 Move first. 4 Phone last. 5 One hard thing before noon.
caption:
A good morning isn't a mood. It's a setting.

1. Fix the wake time
2. Decide the night before
3. Move first
4. Phone last
5. One hard thing before noon

Set it once and stop negotiating with yourself every day.

Run like clockwork.

#clockworklifestyle #morningroutine #habits #discipline #selfimprovement
